prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 16 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1213; do not mention it.)
text: The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion, and pain radiating into the upper arm. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction and external rotation, and mild weakness with resisted movements. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture or dislocation, with soft tissue findings consistent with a rotator cuff strain. The patient was started on a structured physical therapy program combined with a short course of anti-inflammatory medication and activity modification. Over sixteen supervised visits, the patient progressed through passive range-of-motion work, graduated strengthening, and postural training. By the most recent visit, pain had decreased substantially, active range of motion was nearly symmetric with the uninjured side, and strength had improved to near-normal grades. Residual mild discomfort with overhead lifting persists. Continued home exercise and a periodic reassessment are recommended, with return to full duties anticipated once overhead strength tolerance is confirmed.
